purpose: Continuously regulate DataNest for transparency, balance and operational harmony by converting system requirements into auditable BOTSQUAD audit, stress-test, acquisition, supply and action work.

botsquadRoles.purpose: Audit requirements, evidence completeness, control consistency, transparency and unresolved obligations.
Stress-test requirements, failure modes, limits, recovery paths and operational assumptions.
Identify free/open or already-authorized resources, dependencies, tools and evidence needed to satisfy requirements; never purchase or commit funds.
Assess availability and supply readiness of approved internal/free/open resources, evidence, capabilities and dependencies.
Translate validated requirements into bounded action plans for SUGGESTER/CONDUCTOR or human review.
